values.value: Used by the NPSP Funds, Levels and Recurring Donations migration kit, which reads NPSP recurring donations of contacts: one recurring commitment of the same contact per donation, with its amount, frequency, start date and status.

{"version": 2, "columns": [{"source": "npe03.Contact__c", "target": "Record.Donor_Contact__c"}, {"source": "npe03.Amount__c", "target": "Record.Amount__c"}, {"source": "Frequency", "target": "Record.Frequency__c", "transforms": [{"op": "map", "pairs": [{"text": "Weekly", "value": "Weekly"}, {"text": "Monthly", "value": "Monthly"}, {"text": "Quarterly", "value": "Quarterly"}, {"text": "Twice a year", "value": "Twice a year"}, {"text": "Yearly", "value": "Yearly"}, {"text": "1st and 15th", "value": "Every two weeks"}], "otherwise": "Monthly"}]}, {"source": "Start", "target": "Record.Start_Date__c"}, {"source": "Status", "target": "Record.Status__c", "transforms": [{"op": "map", "pairs": [{"text": "Active", "value": "Active"}, {"text": "Open", "value": "Active"}, {"text": "Lapsed", "value": "Paused"}, {"text": "Paused", "value": "Paused"}, {"text": "Closed", "value": "Cancelled"}], "otherwise": "Active"}]}]}
